description:
Open a memory as a floating card in the Neural Interface. Use card_list first to see viewport size.

Coordinate modes (coordMode): "px" (default) = absolute pixels. "pct" = percentage of viewport (0-100), e.g. left:50 top:50 = center of screen.

If the card is already open, it is brought to the front. Omit left/top for auto-cascade positioning.

compact.description: Open in compact mode (220x120px mini-card). Default: false.

coordMode.description: Coordinate mode. "px" (default) = absolute pixels. "pct" = percentage of viewport (0-100). left:50 top:50 = center of screen.

left.description: X position from left edge. Omit for auto-cascade.

memoryId.description: UUID of the memory to open as a floating card

top.description: Y position from top edge. Omit for auto-cascade.

name: card_open
